title: Practice 2: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **выраже́ние** — act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**выражение** — выраже́ние: act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts; face expression; phrase, sentence; (maths, computing) expression. Wiktionary: вы́разить + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **бие́ние** — beating, beat, throb, pulse. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**реше́ние** — decision, solution, answer. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**решение** — реше́ние: decision, solution, answer; solving, deciding, determining; (legal) resolution, judgment, decree, verdict. Wiktionary: реши́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: положе́ние — position, location; отноше́ние — attitude; выраже́ние — act of expressing something, mostly one's feelings or thoughts; бие́ние — beating, beat, throb, pulse.
**уче́ние** — learning, instruction, training, drill, exercising. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Patience is the mother of science.
exercises.why: **учения** — уче́ние: learning, instruction, training, drill, exercising; doctrine; apprenticeship. Wiktionary: учи́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **мне́ние** — opinion (person's). Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**мнение** — мне́ние: opinion (person's); opinion (official statement). Wiktionary: мнить + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **представле́ние** — introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another). Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: I have no way of knowing.
exercises.why: **представления** — представле́ние: introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another); presentation, submission, introduction; performance, show; idea, notion, conception. Wiktionary: предста́вить + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
